intro: The Elemental Plane is an interconnected pocket dimension forged by the titan-forged Keepers to imprison Azeroth's chaotic elementals. Divided into four distinct realms—Skywall, Deepholm, the Abyssal Maw, and the Firelands—it confines the primordial spirits away from the mortal world. Though sealed long ago, cracks in its barriers allow violent elemental incursions and catastrophic summonings into Azeroth.

p: In the ancient days following the fall of the Old Gods, the titan-forged Keepers faced a dilemma: Azeroth's chaotic elementals could not truly be destroyed, as their essences were fundamentally tied to the world. The Keepers devised an enduring solution by weaving an isolated pocket dimension known as the Elemental Plane. Within it, they crafted four interlinked domains tailored to each primal force: Skywall for air, Deepholm for earth, the Abyssal Maw for water, and the Firelands for fire. The elemental lords and their myriad servants were banished into this realm, and powerful wards were set to sever the prison from the material world, allowing Azeroth's surface to finally know peace.

Banishment did not temper the fury of the elementals. Confined within their pocket dimensions, the primordial powers waged endless wars against one another. The most terrible conflict, the Elemental Sundering, pitted the domains of fire and air against each other in a war that raged for millennia across the core of their prison. Meanwhile, a handful of elementals left behind on Azeroth gradually lost their fiery tempestuousness over ages, their forms softening into creatures of flesh and blood.

The barriers separating Azeroth from the Elemental Plane are formidable, but not unbreakable. Two centuries ago, during the desperate climax of the War of the Three Hammers, Sorcerer-Thane Thaurissan pierced the veil to summon Ragnaros the Firelord from the Firelands, an apocalyptic event that ruptured the Redridge Mountains and forged Blackrock Mountain. In recent days, volatile cracks have opened across Kalimdor. Dimensional rifts repeatedly manifest in Silithus, Un'Goro Crater, Azshara, and Winterspring, disgorging waves of hostile elementals eager to test the defenses of the mortal world.
